definitions.gloss: by far; far more; much; considerably
definitions.explanation: Used before comparatives to emphasize a large degree of difference between two things.

examples.japanese: ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はるかに⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧はるかに⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧。
examples.english: This summer is much hotter than last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧みる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{想像|そうぞう}していた→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧はるかに⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: When I actually tried it, it was far more difficult than I had imagined.

notes:
An adverb used to emphasize a significant degree of difference in comparisons. It always modifies a comparative expression — typically an adjective or adverb used with より. It can also be written in kanji as ⟦{遥|はる}か→遥か：10388_haruka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, though the hiragana form is more common in modern writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧はるかに〜: A is far more ~ than B
- ⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧はるかに: far more than imagined
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧はるかに: far more than expected

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧: much; by far — slightly more casual, used in the same comparative patterns
- ⟦{遥|はる}か→遥か：10388_haruka⟧: far; distant — the base adjective form, used for spatial or temporal distance (e.g., はるか⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧ "long, long ago")
- だいぶ: considerably — indicates a notable degree but weaker emphasis than はるかに
